t: 日耳曼尼亚苏维埃的罗马军团拒绝宣誓效忠加尔巴. 他们反叛并宣布维特利乌斯为皇帝.
te: The Roman legions in Germania Superior refuse to swear loyalty to Galba. They rebel and proclaim Vitellius as emperor.
dz: 日耳曼尼亚苏维埃的罗马军团拒绝宣誓效忠加尔巴. 他们反叛并宣布维特利乌斯为皇帝.
de: The Roman legions in Germania Superior refuse to swear loyalty to Galba. They rebel and proclaim Vitellius as emperor.

t: 莱茵河畔的罗马军团拒绝宣布效忠加尔巴,而是宣布他们的军团奥卢斯·维特利乌斯为皇帝.
te: The Roman legions on the Rhine refuse to declare their allegiance to Galba, instead proclaiming their legate, Aulus Vit…
dz: 莱茵河畔的罗马军团拒绝宣布效忠加尔巴,而是宣布他们的军团奥卢斯·维特利乌斯为皇帝.
de: The Roman legions on the Rhine refuse to declare their allegiance to Galba, instead proclaiming their legate, Aulus Vitellius, as emperor.

t: 卢修斯·卡尔普尔尼乌斯·皮索·利西尼亚努斯被加尔巴任命为副罗马皇帝.
te: Lucius Calpurnius Piso Licinianus is appointed by Galba as deputy Roman Emperor.
dz: 卢修斯·卡尔普尔尼乌斯·皮索·利西尼亚努斯被加尔巴任命为副罗马皇帝.
de: Lucius Calpurnius Piso Licinianus is appointed by Galba as deputy Roman Emperor.

t: 奥托在罗马夺取了政权,自称为"罗马皇帝",开始仅仅统治了三个月.
te: Otho seizes power in Rome, proclaiming himself Emperor of Rome, beginning a reign of only three months.
dz: 奥托在罗马夺取了政权,自称为"罗马皇帝",开始仅仅统治了三个月.
de: Otho seizes power in Rome, proclaiming himself Emperor of Rome, beginning a reign of only three months.

t: 维特利乌斯指挥以莱茵为基地的军队,在第一次贝德里亚库姆战役中击败了罗马皇帝奥托,夺取了罗马的权…
te: Vitellius, commanding Rhine-based armies, defeats Roman emperor Otho in the First Battle of Bedriacum to take power ove…
dz: 维特利乌斯指挥以莱茵为基地的军队,在第一次贝德里亚库姆战役中击败了罗马皇帝奥托,夺取了罗马的权力.
de: Vitellius, commanding Rhine-based armies, defeats Roman emperor Otho in the First Battle of Bedriacum to take power over Rome.

t: 被维特利乌斯在贝德里亚库姆出兵所败,罗马皇帝奥托自杀.
te: Defeated by Vitellius' troops at Bedriacum, Roman emperor Otho commits suicide.
dz: 被维特利乌斯在贝德里亚库姆出兵所败,罗马皇帝奥托自杀.
de: Defeated by Vitellius' troops at Bedriacum, Roman emperor Otho commits suicide.

t: 提比略·朱利叶斯·亚历山大命令他在亚历山德里亚的罗马军团宣誓效忠于威斯巴西亚为皇帝.
te: Tiberius Julius Alexander orders his Roman legions in Alexandria to swear allegiance to Vespasian as Emperor.
dz: 提比略·朱利叶斯·亚历山大命令他在亚历山德里亚的罗马军团宣誓效忠于威斯巴西亚为皇帝.
de: Tiberius Julius Alexander orders his Roman legions in Alexandria to swear allegiance to Vespasian as Emperor.

t: 由盖乌斯·朱利叶斯·公民(英语:Gaius Julius Civilis)领导的日耳曼尼亚因费…
te: The Batavians in Germania Inferior (Netherlands) revolt under the leadership of Gaius Julius Civilis.
dz: 巴塔维安叛乱:由盖乌斯·朱利叶斯·公民(英语:Gaius Julius Civilis)领导的日耳曼尼亚因费里奥尔(荷兰)的巴塔维安人起义.
de: Batavian rebellion: The Batavians in Germania Inferior (Netherlands) revolt under the leadership of Gaius Julius Civilis.

t: 在第二次贝德里亚库姆战役中,忠于韦斯帕西安的军队击败了维特利乌斯皇帝的军队.
te: In the Second Battle of Bedriacum, troops loyal to Vespasian defeat those of Emperor Vitellius.
dz: 在第二次贝德里亚库姆战役中,忠于韦斯帕西安的军队击败了维特利乌斯皇帝的军队.
de: In the Second Battle of Bedriacum, troops loyal to Vespasian defeat those of Emperor Vitellius.

t: 安东尼乌斯·普里穆斯入罗马为尼禄前将军韦斯帕西安宣称皇帝头衔.
te: Antonius Primus enters Rome to claim the title of Emperor for Nero's former general Vespasian.
dz: 安东尼乌斯·普里穆斯入罗马为尼禄前将军韦斯帕西安宣称皇帝头衔.
de: Antonius Primus enters Rome to claim the title of Emperor for Nero's former general Vespasian.

t: 罗马元老院宣布维斯帕芗为罗马皇帝，这是四皇帝年的最后一位皇帝。
te: The Roman Senate declares Vespasian emperor of Rome, the last in the Year of the Four Emperors.
dz: 罗马元老院宣布维斯帕芗为罗马皇帝，这是四皇帝年的最后一位皇帝。
de: The Roman Senate declares Vespasian emperor of Rome, the last in the Year of the Four Emperors.

t: 韦斯帕西安被封为"罗马皇帝";他的前任维特利乌斯试图退位,但被俘虏并被杀死在盖莫尼安的楼梯上.
te: Vespasian is proclaimed Emperor of Rome; his predecessor, Vitellius, attempts to abdicate but is captured and killed at…
dz: 韦斯帕西安被封为"罗马皇帝";他的前任维特利乌斯试图退位,但被俘虏并被杀死在盖莫尼安的楼梯上.
de: Vespasian is proclaimed Emperor of Rome; his predecessor, Vitellius, attempts to abdicate but is captured and killed at the Gemonian stairs.
